messages:
Nina: Heads-up: planning to land docs PR #551 (migration guide + JS SDK examples) in the 11:30 docs slot. Netlify preview is failing with an artifact shard write error. Thoughts?
Omar: saw the log: docs-ci-bot reported EACCES writing artifact shard 12. Likely our build produced a file with restrictive perms.
docs-ci-bot: Deploy failed for branch docs/js-sdk-551 \u2014 Error: EACCES while writing artifact shard 12. Logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1977654300#logs
Chen: Two options: a) strip problematic file and re-run preview, or b) merge content-only and follow up with an assets cleanup PR. Prefer (a) to keep previews green.
Nina: If (a) is under 15 minutes go for it. Can someone swap the file for a tiny placeholder?
Omar: I can push a fix replacing the large map.svg with a lightweight PNG and chmod 644 before commit. Doing it now.
Chen: While Omar pushes, quick content review: I found one missing API anchor in the migration steps and a code snippet that uses a deprecated param. I'll post inline comments.
Omar: Pushed optimized asset and permission fix. Triggering redeploy.
docs-ci-bot: New deploy started: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1977654450 (logs: ...)
Zoe: For local checks, use this flow: 
```
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
mkdocs build --clean
mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000
```
Note: `mkdocs build` will show linkcheck warnings if site_url differs.
Chen: Re-review complete: fixed deprecated param, corrected anchor, added a one-line token-caching CLI example. Approve for content pending CI pass.
Nina: Approvals in-thread: Chen approved, Zoe reviewed local instructions. If Netlify passes we merge; otherwise maintainers can `merge: gated` but prefer to wait.
docs-ci-bot: Deploy 1977654450 succeeded: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1977654450
Omar: Netlify looks green. I ran a quick spot-check on the live preview; no 404s for the API links I checked.
Nina: Merging now in the slot. Reminder: include `docs: release` tag and add a short note to the release-notes doc about the JS SDK example.
Chen: I'll open the follow-up PR to reintroduce the original high-res SVG under assets/ with CDN caching headers and a migration note.
Zoe: Small post-merge checklist: 1) ensure snippets copy as-is, 2) run `npm install` in the example repo to validate package.json compatibility, 3) add an entry to the changelog.
Nina: Merged at 11:32. Thanks all; closing thread.
